Savory and Sweet Watermelon Salad
By: Emme Ribeiro
Published: Sunday, August 1, 2010 - 10:22am

Ingredients




2 cups cubed seedless watermelon
2 cups cubed cucumber
1 small red onion, finely diced
1 cup ricotta salata cheese (or feta cheese), crumbled
1 cup mint leaves, chopped
1/4 cup extra virgin olinve oil
1/4 cup balsamic vinegar

Preparation

1 In a large bowl, combine cucumber, onion, mint leaves with the olive oil and balsamic vinegar. 2 Mix until everything is well incorporated. 3 Add watermelon and cheese and gently mix into the salad.
